description: The prototype's scenario: the Saturday notes are piled on top of each other inside their frame and the model is asked to arrange them. Only `move` (frame-relative) can do it, so it measures the read payload's sizes and the space ops are written in.
title: Vienna weekend
request: The Saturday notes are piled on top of each other. Arrange them neatly inside the Saturday frame, in the order of the day, so that none of them overlaps.
